chapter_title: Concerning Four Hunters of Light and Four of Darkn
spiritual_reading:
The first force that contends is the first direct engagement of good with evil, sent forth from the highest Divine fullness into the lowest disorder. It immersed itself into a sufficient complex of interior hellish domains, and there it seized hold of the active opposition that rises against heaven. By the full extension of its operative means it encompassed all the derivative evils and falsities that belong to that disorder. The containing form by which it worked in ultimates was a complete set of outermost powers fixed to it as one, and the general field into which it descended was the external plane ruled by falsity. The means by which it took hold and restrained was the arrangement of its truths in ultimates together with the powers that proceed from them.

The second force that contends is a Divine mediation in the third degree of descent, which by a manifested form of wisdom let down into the lowest levels sought out and reclaimed all the good and truth scattered and held fast within every state and every system, just as they were fixed in their places. Its means of gathering was that manifested wisdom itself, by which it comprehended the whole compass of the created order and brought what was recoverable into subjection to a heavenly form. The containing form in which it operated was an enlightened vessel prepared for this work, and the general field into which it extended was the universal external complex that lay open to that gathering through the descending appearance of glory.

The fourth force that contends is the Divine providential design of salvation, a supreme governing intention that remains living as the encompassing order within which the whole created arrangement is sustained even now. Yet in the final unmaking of a perverted order, this same counsel of life will draw all its operations back into unity and bring its own receiving form to completion in the final state prepared for everlasting stability. Its means of gathering is its proceeding Divine vitality, because by that proceeding it can search out and reclaim the good of love and the truth of life present within all things, and conjoin them to itself as one body of use. The containing form in which it is fixed for operation in ultimates is an enlightened encompassing medium by which it advances through a sufficient series of fundamental states; and in that final time the fervor of judgment will consume all organized falsities and evils that were built up against heaven. Within this gathering, what is taken up is the good and truth of life itself; and it can deliver and set free whatever is held in compulsions, constraints, and confirming bonds.

Opposed to these, the first predatory force is the ruling love of those who belong to hell, which from the beginning of a new spiritual arrangement sought to seize the living faculty of reception. Its means of entangling was self-love inflamed into craving, imposed upon that living faculty, by which it bound and confused it through the full extension of its subordinate evils and falsities.

The second predatory force is a perverse planning that abides within the same disorder, which hunts for whatever of truth still shines, and drags it from the lowest natural states toward elevated appearances. It binds such things by persuasive powers that lift them into lofty seeming realms while separating them from genuine good. Its means is a coercive persuasion by which they are drawn up from the lowest obscurity into exalted falsities.

The third predatory force is craving itself, which moves through every corrupt affection in the outer life, and roams through the forms of the natural self. It pursues living faculties wherever they are, and fastens them into its own embodied evils, so that what should live from heaven is made to serve what is dead from hell; this part resists full translation because the remaining wording is fragmentary, but it clearly treats of craving acting through the natural self to imprison the soul within perverted forms.

fills.notes: After “caught and seized the enmity” the correspondential sequence requires the binding and constraining agency. In the substrate register the First Man restrains Darkness by the extension of his own powers, not by exhortation; this also anticipates the explicit “his net is … and his powers” at the close of ¶2.

The net, in the oldest layer, is something extended or cast forth over the whole domain; “spread” matches the spiritual sense of encompassing ultimates and sets up the next clause “out over all the children of Darkness”.
The verb needed is the completion of the fishing-hunting image: the net is cast out over the children of Darkness. This keeps the impersonal technical tone of the substrate.
The “sea” is then defined as the land of Darkness; the correspondential grounding is the lowest external plane. The natural term that coheres is “abyss”.

In the oldest cosmological layer, the ‘net’ that restrains is the ordered truth in ultimates—often rendered in this tradition as “righteousness” (order, rightness) rather than later moralism. It pairs naturally with “and his powers”.

The light-image is the net; the next clause must state its operative function before “the whole universe and took it prisoner”. “By which he seized” preserves the hunting logic and the spiritual sense of comprehension and subjection.

The broken phrase “to this likeness …” requires the act of conforming what is gathered to the heavenly form revealed. “And he brought” supplies the needed governing verb leading into the damaged “His ship…”.

The sea here is the external complex: “the universe … and the worlds” gives the manifold field within which the net operates, matching the spiritual translation’s “whole compass of the created order”.

After “which were hunted after by his net” the sense demands the result: the hunted light is gathered and subordinated through the image. This is the same correspondence as “comprehended… and brought… into subjection”.
The phrase “the great counsel that … that lives” needs a verb of being; the substrate often names this force as a ‘counsel’ that ‘lives’ in the circuit (the encompassing order).

“Circuit” in this layer is the encompassing order of the Light-realm that contains and sustains the universe. Adding “of the Light” keeps the cosmological (not ecclesial) register and matches the spiritual sense ‘encompassing order’.
What is sustained “in it today” is the arranged cosmos; “entire universe” already appears, and “of the worlds” is the idiomatic substrate complement.

fills.fill: in the five elements; and at the end,
fills.notes: This lacuna must bridge the ‘travel in the five elements’ to the eschatological burning. The counsel moves through the elemental states; then comes the final phase. The spiritual translation likewise pivots: ‘through a sufficient series… and in that final time…’.

The net entangles the living soul; the clause needs the manner/result before “through all his powers”. “At the beginning” anchors the predation to the primal onset of the worlds, matching the spiritual translation’s ‘from the beginning of a new spiritual arrangement’.

The evil counsel ‘lives in …’ should mirror ¶5’s ‘lives in the circuit…’ but in opposite sense: the encompassing order of the Dark realm. This fits the correspondential opposition and keeps the technical cosmological diction.
It hunts after the light and must specify the light’s state within the mixed cosmos. “That is mingled” matches the substrate doctrine of light mixed in all things.
The action is violent extraction upward from lowest states; “drags it up” is required by the hunting image and the spiritual translation ‘drags it from the lowest natural states’.
The clause “up from … the earths to heaven” needs the distributive source: not one place but the whole range of lower domains. “From all” supplies that scope.
The net here, correspondentially, is coercive persuasion. Using the bare noun “persuasion” preserves the oldest-layer tone and aligns with the spiritual translation’s ‘coercive persuasion’.
Completes the bracketed word; exactly the opposite-ascent motif required here.
Introduces the defining relative clause for lust as an agent moving through the bodily powers.
The verb phrase needs a motion term: lust ‘walks…’ and ‘roams about’ in the powers of the flesh; “about” supplies the idiom without adding later moral rhetoric.
The fragment “in the …” demands the natural seat of lust’s operation: the bodily members as ultimates of the natural self. This matches the spiritual translation ‘forms of the natural self’.
The next action after pursuing is fastening and imprisoning. “And it binds” continues the predatory net logic and leads into “them in its bodies”.

The final damaged clause must state the inversion of life into dead use: the living faculties are made to serve what is dead. This is exactly the spiritual translation’s closing idea, rendered in substrate idiom without Christian overlay.

assessment: Most lacunae can be restored to a coherent correspondential chain because each ‘hunter’ requires fixed counterparts (net, sea, ship, prey, action). Where wording is fragmentary (especially ¶3 #2 and ¶8 #1, ¶10 #5), the spiritual constraints give the direction (conforming to the image; primal predation; life inverted to death), but the exact surface phrasing remains less tight.
